Kuvera doesn’t have proper tracking of UPI failures - instead you need to share all proofs for their support team to validate and complete the transactions. Leads to serious frustration- when your funds are in dark and status unknown. 2) When markets are highly volatile - avoid using Kuvera for MF investments. Even if you have success on the transaction, there is a possibility that your NAV is not of same day. Kuvera generally puts it back in BSEStar platform - which may be right, but for me I expected their platform to be resilient. Currently, stability is a serious issue. In the digital world, I wouldn’t expect customer to keep on sharing proofs to Kuvera team to prove that transactions are correctly submitted. 3) Support team has some gap in understanding queries. Many a times, multiple emails has to be triggered to explain the scenario and finally you get a response - which is completely out of context. 4) I still struggle for transaction units which are lost through Kuvera - still don’t have a trace of what happened and kept proving that it’s missing. Analysis and response from support is definitely a concern. 5) Kuvera is still not in a matured state and would expect them to standardise their operations, support, stability, resilience and finally transactions tracking seamlessly. - all above are my experience.
